title: THE SCHOOL OFFICE IS A ROCKET? 🚀
topic: The Principal's hidden escape plan takes flight.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE SELF-DESTRUCT TIMER JUST HIT ZERO [beat] BUT INSTEAD OF AN EXPLOSION THE ENTIRE OFFICE FLOOR IS LITERALLY LIFTING OFF THE GROUND!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You idiots thought I was hiding evidence [beat] but this school was built on top of a decommissioned rocket silo for a very specific reason!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: We are officially three hundred feet in the air [beat] and I can see the cafeteria ladies looking like tiny ants from this window right now!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: If we are actually going to space [beat] I am definitely not finishing my math homework because gravity won't even exist up there anyway!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Shut up Ding [beat] we need to find the master override key before we hit terminal velocity and burn up in the atmosphere like crispy nuggets!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: The key is hidden inside the one place you kids never dare to look [beat] my personal drawer of confiscated neon fidget spinners from five years ago!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: There are thousands of them in here [beat] it is like a graveyard of plastic toys and for some reason every single one of them is glowing blue!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait a second [beat] these aren't just cheap toys, they are actually miniature hard drives containing every student's deepest and darkest secrets!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Give me my spinner back Nix [beat] or I will throw you out of this flying office without a parachute before we even hit the clouds!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Stop fighting you fools [beat] the oxygen levels are dropping because someone forgot to seal the ventilation shaft in the staff bathroom downstairs!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I finally found the override disk [beat] but it requires a biometric thumbprint that only the legendary janitor possesses and he is off at lunch!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As the school office reaches the stratosphere [beat] Nix realizes the real explosion wasn't fire, it was the truth about to leak to the world.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The screen says the files are uploading to the internet [beat] everyone is about to see exactly what the Principal did with all that prom money!
